name: Asami
source:
A high-handed and authoritative young lady, she seems to be the daughter of some renowned family. She refers to the protagonist as “Otaku-kun” and has a strong overpowering personality, but also has a hidden cute side to her. A typical tsundere, she holds the protagonist captive due to a certain incident.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2019/10/04/ae/]official website[/url]]
